name: Comboflare Combo Discounts for WooCommerce
author: asrsagar087

sections.description:
Comboflare helps WooCommerce store owners create mix-and-match product combos with tiered percentage or fixed discounts and display them anywhere with a shortcode.

Features include:

  • Create multiple combo rules from WooCommerce admin.
  • Select eligible products and product categories.
  • Percentage or fixed discount tiers.
  • Simple and variable product support.
  • Server-side product, variation, eligibility, tier, and price validation.
  • Independent combo groups in the cart.
  • Combo item quantity protection.
  • Product-level discount calculation for WooCommerce tax, coupon, checkout, and order totals.
  • Combo information stored on order line items.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatibility declaration.
  • Responsive combo builder.

After creating a rule, place the combo builder on a page with:

[cmbflr_combo id="123"]

Replace 123 with the combo rule ID.

Privacy

Comboflare Combo Discounts for WooCommerce does not send plugin data to external services. Combo configuration is stored in the WordPress database, and combo identifiers are stored with WooCommerce cart/order data when applicable.

Data retention

Uninstalling the plugin removes the plugin version option but intentionally retains combo rules and WooCommerce order metadata to avoid accidental store configuration or historical order-data loss. Store administrators can remove combo rules before uninstalling if they no longer need them.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the comboflare-combo-discounts folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate WooCommerce.
  3. Activate Comboflare Combo Discounts for WooCommerce.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Combo Discounts.
  5. Create a rule, select products/categories, and configure at least one discount tier.
  6. Add [cmbflr_combo id="RULE_ID"] to the page where the builder should appear.
sections.faq:
Does it support variable products?

Yes. Customers select variation attributes in the combo builder and the server validates the matching WooCommerce variation before it is added to the cart.

Can customers manipulate prices in JavaScript?

Frontend prices are previews only. Eligible products, variations, tiers, and prices are recalculated on the server.

Can a coupon be used with a combo?

Yes. Combo discounts are applied to product prices before WooCommerce calculates eligible coupons. Normal WooCommerce coupon restrictions still apply.

What happens if a customer removes a combo item?

The combo group is recalculated. If it no longer reaches a configured tier, the combo discount is removed.

Are combo rules deleted on uninstall?

No. Combo rules are intentionally retained to avoid accidental store configuration loss. The plugin version option is removed.
